title: Simulator
subtitle: Creates orders and deliveries like a real restaurant — to show the system at work. Everything goes through the regular API.

speed.label: Speed
speed.hint: How many times faster model time runs than real time.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.subtitle: What is happening in the “restaurant”. Switches on the fly.

Normal.title: Normal day
Normal.text: A steady flow of orders, deliveries on schedule.

RushHour.title: Rush hour
RushHour.text: Several times more orders — products run out fast, dishes go into the stop list.

SupplyDelay.title: Delivery delay
SupplyDelay.text: Suppliers are late — watch the stop list and the shortage forecast grow.

Spoilage.title: Spoilage
Spoilage.text: Products arrive with a short shelf life — write-offs and “What to sell” grow.

FreshDelivery.title: Fresh delivery
FreshDelivery.text: A large delivery — stock fills up, dishes come back on the menu.

Chaos.title: Chaos
Chaos.text: Everything at once: peaks, delays, cancellations and repeated requests — a resilience test.

activity.subtitle: The simulator's latest actions.
